description: Version 1.19 (gripper only; builds on 1.18, related pebble voice-07e1e6a1). Jake: make the section from where the finger starts rounding to the tip much thicker. Extend the width outward through that rounded section, but it should still come to a point at the tip.
summary: In version 1.19, the gripper finger's rounded section, from where rounding starts to the tip, is too thin. Thicken that section outward, building on 1.18, while the tip still tapers to a point.
